gloss: numerous; a great number of; many

definitions.gloss: numerous; a great number of; many
definitions.explanation: A somewhat formal way to express that there are many of something. Functions as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}くの{問題|もんだい}がある。
{数多|かずおお}くの{経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}んできた。
examples.english: I have accumulated a great deal of experience.

examples.japanese: この{作家|さっか}は{数多|かずおお}くの{作品|さくひん}を{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: This author has produced a great many works.

notes: More literary and emphatic than {多|おお}くの or たくさんの. Can also be read as {数多|あまた}の in a more literary register. Always used before a noun. Also used adverbially without の: {数多|かずおお}く{存在|そんざい}する (to exist in large numbers). Related: {多|おお}くの (many), たくさんの (lots of), {無数|むすう}の (countless).
